events.title: OpenAI launches Astra for Law with a dedicated legal index
events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出带专用法律索引的 Astra for Law
events.summary: OpenAI combines GPT-6 Astra, legal-analysis instructions and a legal index covering more than 230 million URLs. On 200 private legal-research questions, it reports 54.0% correctness versus 38.7% for Astra with ordinary web search. Selected firms receive Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex; the gpt-6-astra-law API is not yet available. The launch includes 26 partner plugins and 47 adaptable skills.
events.why_it_matters: For legal AI teams, domain retrieval and workflow packaging appear to add more value than a base-model swap alone. Treat the result as a limited-access product trial because the benchmark is private and vendor-reported. API integration work should wait for documented availability and data-governance terms.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 把 GPT-6 Astra、法律分析指令与覆盖超过 2.3 亿个 URL 的法律索引组合成 Astra for Law。在 200 道私有法律研究题上，官方报告正确率为 54.0%，普通 web search 的 Astra 为 38.7%。部分律所可在 ChatGPT 与 Codex 中获得 Trusted Access；`gpt-6-astra-law` API 尚未开放。发布还包含 26 个合作方 plugin 和 47 个可改造 skill。
events.summary_en: OpenAI combines GPT-6 Astra, legal-analysis instructions and a legal index covering more than 230 million URLs. On 200 private legal-research questions, it reports 54.0% correctness versus 38.7% for Astra with ordinary web search. Selected firms receive Trusted Access in ChatGPT and Codex; the gpt-6-astra-law API is not yet available. The launch includes 26 partner plugins and 47 adaptable skills.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对法律 AI 团队来说，专用检索与工作流封装带来的增益可能大于单纯换底座模型。由于 benchmark 私有且数字来自厂商，当前只适合有限范围试验。API 集成应等正式开放与数据治理条款明确后再投入。
events.why_it_matters_en: For legal AI teams, domain retrieval and workflow packaging appear to add more value than a base-model swap alone. Treat the result as a limited-access product trial because the benchmark is private and vendor-reported. API integration work should wait for documented availability and data-governance terms.

events.title: Anthropic opens verified access for higher-risk biology work
events.title_zh: Anthropic 为高风险生物研究开放验证访问
events.summary: Anthropic's Life Sciences Verification Program gives vetted Team, Enterprise and first-party API organizations more permissive biology access. Standard Use applies refined classifiers to Mythos 5.1, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5. High-risk Use is a project-scoped add-on after further review. Anthropic pairs relaxed request blocking with cross-session offline monitoring and 30-day retention for flagged activity.
events.why_it_matters: For life-science teams, access policy is moving from one global safety boundary to verified, project-scoped tiers. That unlocks legitimate workflows but adds monitoring and retention obligations that belong in procurement review. The beta remains application-gated and has no independent adoption audit.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 的 Life Sciences Verification Program 让通过审核的 Team、Enterprise 与第一方 API 组织获得更宽松的生物研究访问。Standard Use 为 Mythos 5.1、Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 使用更细的分类器；High-risk Use 需按项目额外审核。放宽逐请求拦截的同时，Anthropic 会做跨会话离线监控，并把命中活动保留 30 天。

Standard Use applies refined classifiers to Mythos 5.1, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5. High-risk Use is a project-scoped add-on after further review. Anthropic pairs relaxed request blocking with cross-session offline monitoring and 30-day retention for flagged activity.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对生命科学团队来说，访问策略正从统一安全边界转向经过验证、按项目分级的权限。它能释放正当工作流，但监控与留存义务也应进入采购审查。该计划仍是申请制 beta，且没有独立采用审计。

That unlocks legitimate workflows but adds monitoring and retention obligations that belong in procurement review. The beta remains application-gated and has no independent adoption audit.

events.title: Anthropic releases 36 Claude-built biomolecular optimization kits
events.title_zh: Anthropic 开源 36 套 Claude 生物分子优化工具包
events.summary: Anthropic says a general-purpose internal research model, supervised by two domain specialists, optimized more than 30 biomolecular models in under four weeks. Thirty-six Apache-2.0 drop-in kits are public with pinned upstream versions and exact, fast or big modes. The company reports about 4x average speedup with minimal precision loss and nearly 2x with identical outputs. Very large capability runs completed but produced invalid collapsed structures.
events.why_it_matters: For scientific-software teams, this is a concrete example of an agent improving many mature codebases rather than solving one benchmark task. The pinned kits make reproduction practical, but the repository is an unmaintained reference release and the performance claims are first-party. Validate scientific outputs, not just kernel speed.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，一款通用内部研究模型在两位领域专家监督下，用不到四周优化了 30 多个生物分子模型。项目公开 36 套 Apache-2.0 即插即用工具包，固定上游版本，并提供 exact、fast 或 big 模式。官方报告平均约 4 倍加速且精度损失很小；保持完全相同输出时接近 2 倍。超大规模能力测试虽能运行，但生成了错误的坍缩结构。
events.summary_en: Anthropic says a general-purpose internal research model, supervised by two domain specialists, optimized more than 30 biomolecular models in under four weeks. Thirty-six Apache-2.0 drop-in kits are public with pinned upstream versions and exact, fast or big modes. The company reports about 4x average speedup with minimal precision loss and nearly 2x with identical outputs. Very large capability runs completed but produced invalid collapsed structures.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对科学软件团队来说，这是 agent 批量改进成熟代码库的实证，而不是只解一道 benchmark。固定版本的工具包便于复现，但仓库明确不持续维护，性能数字也来自厂商。验收时必须检查科学结果，而不能只看 kernel 速度。
events.why_it_matters_en: For scientific-software teams, this is a concrete example of an agent improving many mature codebases rather than solving one benchmark task. The pinned kits make reproduction practical, but the repository is an unmaintained reference release and the performance claims are first-party. Validate scientific outputs, not just kernel speed.

events.title: Anthropic publishes monitoring metrics for a 30,000-agent fleet
events.title_zh: Anthropic 公布 3 万 agent 集群的监控指标
events.summary: Anthropic proposes recurring measures for AI-led R&D, agent-monitor coverage and R&D compute allocation. It reports roughly 30,000 concurrent internal research and engineering agents on its largest platform, full online and offline monitor coverage, more than one billion online decisions in August and about 50 weekly human escalations. Claude led 26% of measured AI R&D work and collaborated or led on more than 90%; none was fully autonomous.
events.why_it_matters: For operators of large agent fleets, this is rare scale data on monitoring volume, latency and human escalation. It supports designing two-stage monitoring rather than inspecting every trace manually. The taxonomy and measurements are company-reported, so they are useful operating references, not neutral benchmarks.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 提出三类持续指标：AI 主导研发的占比、agent monitor 的覆盖/延迟/升级，以及研发算力分配。其最大内部平台约有 3 万个并发研究与工程 agent，在线和离线监控覆盖率为 100%；8 月在线判断超过 10 亿次，每周约 50 次升级到人工。Claude 主导了 26% 的被测研发工作，参与或主导超过 90%，但没有任务完全自主完成。
events.summary_en: Anthropic proposes recurring measures for AI-led R&D, agent-monitor coverage and R&D compute allocation. It reports roughly 30,000 concurrent internal research and engineering agents on its largest platform, full online and offline monitor coverage, more than one billion online decisions in August and about 50 weekly human escalations. Claude led 26% of measured AI R&D work and collaborated or led on more than 90%; none was fully autonomous.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对大规模 agent 集群的运营者来说，这是少见的监控量、延迟与人工升级数据，支持采用两级监控，而不是人工检查每条轨迹。分类与测量均来自公司内部，因此更适合作为运营参考，而不是中立 benchmark。
events.why_it_matters_en: For operators of large agent fleets, this is rare scale data on monitoring volume, latency and human escalation. It supports designing two-stage monitoring rather than inspecting every trace manually. The taxonomy and measurements are company-reported, so they are useful operating references, not neutral benchmarks.

events.title: Google gives its family agent a separate identity and permission boundary
events.title_zh: Google 为家庭 agent 设置独立身份与权限边界
events.summary: Google's CC experiment lets up to six people work with one agent that has its own verified Google Account. It separates shared from per-person memory, defines explicit sharing boundaries and integrates Gmail, Chat, Drive, Docs, Calendar and Tasks. The agent runs on an isolated cloud computer using Antigravity and Gemini. Access is an adult, U.S.-only Labs experiment with a waitlist.
events.why_it_matters: For multi-user agents, identity and memory ownership cannot be borrowed from one human account. CC is a concrete design for a shared principal with explicit per-person boundaries. Watch the architecture, but do not infer reliability or adoption from an early consumer experiment with no benchmark data.
events.summary_zh: Google 的 CC 实验让最多六个人与同一个 agent 协作，该 agent 拥有独立验证的 Google Account。它区分共享记忆与个人记忆，设置明确的共享边界，并接入 Gmail、Chat、Drive、Docs、Calendar 和 Tasks。agent 通过 Antigravity 与 Gemini 在隔离云电脑上运行。目前仅面向美国成年用户，是带候补名单的 Labs 实验。
events.summary_en: Google's CC experiment lets up to six people work with one agent that has its own verified Google Account. It separates shared from per-person memory, defines explicit sharing boundaries and integrates Gmail, Chat, Drive, Docs, Calendar and Tasks. The agent runs on an isolated cloud computer using Antigravity and Gemini. Access is an adult, U.S.-only Labs experiment with a waitlist.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多用户 agent 来说，身份和记忆所有权不能直接借用某个用户账号。CC 给出了共享主体、个人边界与独立执行环境的具体设计。它仍是没有 benchmark 的早期消费实验，适合观察架构，不宜推断可靠性或采用规模。
events.why_it_matters_en: For multi-user agents, identity and memory ownership cannot be borrowed from one human account. CC is a concrete design for a shared principal with explicit per-person boundaries. Watch the architecture, but do not infer reliability or adoption from an early consumer experiment with no benchmark data.

events.title: UN Data Commons exposes official statistics to agents through MCP
events.title_zh: UN Data Commons 通过 MCP 向 agent 开放官方统计
events.summary: The UN System Data Commons launches as an open-source, AI-ready knowledge graph built on Google Data Commons. It normalizes metrics, time series and geographic boundaries across UN datasets, supports natural-language exploration and exposes authoritative data to research agents through MCP. The public platform is live, with the UN targeting 80% coverage of its statistical datasets by 2027.
events.why_it_matters: For research-agent builders, MCP now reaches a major authoritative statistics source instead of another application connector. It can reduce custom ingestion and schema work, but current coverage and query-quality measurements are not published. High-stakes figures still need source-level review.
events.summary_zh: UN System Data Commons 正式上线，它是基于 Google Data Commons 的开源、AI-ready 知识图谱。平台统一不同联合国数据集中的指标、时间序列与地理边界，支持自然语言探索，并通过 MCP 向 research agent 提供权威数据。公共平台已经可用，联合国计划在 2027 年覆盖 80% 的统计数据集。
events.summary_en: The UN System Data Commons launches as an open-source, AI-ready knowledge graph built on Google Data Commons. It normalizes metrics, time series and geographic boundaries across UN datasets, supports natural-language exploration and exposes authoritative data to research agents through MCP. The public platform is live, with the UN targeting 80% coverage of its statistical datasets by 2027.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 research agent 开发者来说，MCP 开始连接权威统计数据源，而不只是应用 connector，可减少自建采集与 schema 适配工作。平台没有公布当前覆盖率和查询质量，高风险数字仍需回看原始来源。
events.why_it_matters_en: For research-agent builders, MCP now reaches a major authoritative statistics source instead of another application connector. It can reduce custom ingestion and schema work, but current coverage and query-quality measurements are not published. High-stakes figures still need source-level review.

events.title: GitHub adds adoption telemetry for Copilot agents, skills and MCP
events.title_zh: GitHub 为 Copilot agent、skill 与 MCP 增加采用遥测
events.summary: GitHub's enterprise and organization reports now measure Copilot CLI skills, custom agents, MCP servers, slash commands and plugins. The impact dashboard and API also expose rolling 28-day engagement for code completion, agent edit, code review, cloud agent, CLI and app. Customer-defined names are privacy-grouped. MCP interaction counts measure connection attempts, including failures, rather than tool calls.
events.why_it_matters: For platform teams, agent rollout can now be managed with feature-level adoption data instead of license assignment alone. The new fields help find useful automations and enablement gaps. Interpret MCP counts carefully because failed reconnects can look like engagement.
events.summary_zh: GitHub 的企业与组织报告现在会统计 Copilot CLI 的 skills、custom agents、MCP servers、slash commands 与 plugins。impact dashboard 和 API 还新增 28 天滚动 feature engagement，覆盖 code completion、agent edit、code review、cloud agent、CLI 与 app。自定义名称会为保护隐私而合并显示；MCP interaction 统计的是连接尝试，包括失败，并非工具调用次数。
events.summary_en: GitHub's enterprise and organization reports now measure Copilot CLI skills, custom agents, MCP servers, slash commands and plugins. The impact dashboard and API also expose rolling 28-day engagement for code completion, agent edit, code review, cloud agent, CLI and app. Customer-defined names are privacy-grouped. MCP interaction counts measure connection attempts, including failures, rather than tool calls.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对平台团队来说，agent 推广终于可以看功能级采用，而不只是 license 分配。新字段能找出真正有用的自动化和启用缺口。MCP 指标要谨慎解释，因为失败重连也会被计数。
events.why_it_matters_en: For platform teams, agent rollout can now be managed with feature-level adoption data instead of license assignment alone. The new fields help find useful automations and enablement gaps. Interpret MCP counts carefully because failed reconnects can look like engagement.

events.title: Pydantic AI closes web-fetch policy and telemetry leaks
events.title_zh: Pydantic AI 修复 web fetch 策略绕过与遥测泄露
events.summary: Pydantic AI 2.44.0 fixes four security issues in web fetching and telemetry. Two bypass network or domain policy through IPv6 zone identifiers or hostname normalization. One attacker-controlled page can trigger quadratic processing and block the event loop. Another can export instructions and output templates even when telemetry content is disabled. Version 1.107.6 backports the fixes.
events.why_it_matters: For production agents that fetch arbitrary URLs, these are runtime-boundary flaws rather than cosmetic patches. Upgrade both current and v1 deployments, then test private-address and normalized-hostname cases in local policy. Teams relying on content-redacted telemetry should also review already-exported traces.
events.summary_zh: Pydantic AI 2.44.0 修复了四个与 web fetch 和遥测相关的安全问题。其中两个可通过 IPv6 zone identifier 或 hostname 规范化绕过网络/域策略；一个恶意页面可触发二次方处理并阻塞 event loop；另一个会在关闭遥测内容时仍导出指令和输出模板。1.107.6 已回移这些修复。
events.summary_en: Pydantic AI 2.44.0 fixes four security issues in web fetching and telemetry. Two bypass network or domain policy through IPv6 zone identifiers or hostname normalization. One attacker-controlled page can trigger quadratic processing and block the event loop. Another can export instructions and output templates even when telemetry content is disabled. Version 1.107.6 backports the fixes.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对允许 agent 访问任意 URL 的生产系统来说，这些是运行时边界漏洞，不是普通小修。当前版本与 v1 部署都应升级，并补测私网地址和 hostname 规范化策略。依赖内容脱敏遥测的团队还应审查已导出的 trace。
events.why_it_matters_en: For production agents that fetch arbitrary URLs, these are runtime-boundary flaws rather than cosmetic patches. Upgrade both current and v1 deployments, then test private-address and normalized-hostname cases in local policy. Teams relying on content-redacted telemetry should also review already-exported traces.

technical_details.issues: IPv6 zone SSRF bypass; normalized-host blocklist bypass; quadratic web_fetch; telemetry content leak
technical_details.action: upgrade and retest network policy plus telemetry redaction

technical_details_zh.问题: IPv6 zone SSRF 绕过；hostname blocklist 绕过；web_fetch 二次方处理；遥测内容泄露
technical_details_zh.动作: 升级并重测网络策略与遥测脱敏
